title: Design System: Modern education digital portfolio

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Exact brand green with accessible dark ink.

extensions.scope: Public portfolio and owner interface; document templates preserved

about.content: Existing saved/default content and routes retained

homeTitle.display: white alpha title above teacher name
homeTitle.scope: Home cover only; no manuscript fonts or page theme

narrative.overview: White structured content, navy Arabic typography, ministry green and blue banner. Genuine existing logo assets, real record statistics, ordered performance criteria and accessible course search. Personal portfolio, no official endorsement.
narrative.motion: Native 280ms fade/slide entrances, 250ms control feedback, reduced-motion fallback; no forced scrolling.
narrative.accessibility: Dark ink on bright green; dark scrim over hero gradient, visible focus, native keyboard behavior.
narrative.data: No API, permissions or stored content changes. No invented completion percentages.
